summary: Our inaugural season: BizBuzz delivered school talks, a six-week summer entrepreneurship camp, the Fish Tank pitch competition, and year-round workshops across DuPage County, reaching 720 students.

programs.title: Camp Session 1: Ideation & Innovation
programs.description: Students kicked off our free 2024 Summer Entrepreneurship Camp by exploring the basics of business-minded thinking, learning how to identify and solve real-world problems. After being introduced to concepts like value creation and market fit with 10 instructors, students dove into our Mini Fish Tank activity with $200+ in prizes.

programs.title: Camp Session 2: Unique Value Proposition & Networking
programs.description: Students learned how to craft a unique value proposition for their businesses and practiced their networking skills with 9 instructors. They put their skills to the test in a coffee shop simulation contest with $100 in awards.

programs.title: Camp Session 3: Marketing
programs.description: Students explored marketing, branding, and advertising through activities like the 'Guess the Brand' game and a flyer design challenge with $140 in prizes.

programs.title: Camp Session 4: Public Speaking
programs.description: Students explored the art of sales and pitching. Guided by 14 instructors, they practiced their public speaking skills and competed in an interactive, hands-on pitch contest with over $170 in prizes.

programs.title: Camp Session 5: Finance
programs.description: Students learned the basics of personal and business finance from 16 instructors. They then put their skills to the test in a dream vacation budgeting game with over $330 in prizes.

programs.title: Camp Session 6: Pitching
programs.description: The final session before Fish Tank where students finalized their pitch decks and practiced rehearsing their scripts. Preliminary judges offered exciting feedback.

programs.title: Fish Tank 2024 Finals
programs.description: Two-day pitch event where young entrepreneurs pitch innovative ideas, receive expert feedback, and compete for resources to turn their business concepts into reality. Over 100 competitors, 30+ mentors, and 11 judges.

programs.title: Madison Junior High mxINCedu Mentorship Program
programs.description: A mentorship program enhancing the mxINCedu curriculum with new worksheets, slides, and activities for 90 students.

programs.title: Best Brains Learning Center Workshops
programs.description: Two workshops introducing 20 students to entrepreneurship and the process of turning imagination into innovation.

programs.title: Naperville Children's Business Fair Workshops
programs.description: Three workshops helping 50 students use creative problem-solving, marketing, and finance to launch products sold alongside 150 young entrepreneurs at the Naperville Children's Business Fair.

programs.title: Brookdale Elementary School Workshops
programs.description: Four workshops teaching 20 young entrepreneurs fundamental business skills, culminating in a school Pitch Night for parents and high school guest judges.

programs.title: Crone Middle School Talk
programs.description: A school talk encouraging 60 students to see themselves as problem-solvers and future business creators.

programs.title: Scott Elementary School Talk
programs.description: A school talk inspiring 135 students to explore entrepreneurship by showing how creative ideas can turn into real businesses—even as kids.

timeline.detail: Final camp session with preliminary judge feedback before Fish Tank.

timeline.detail: 100+ students compete at College of DuPage in two-day pitch competition.

timeline.detail: Partnership workshops introducing entrepreneurship to 20 students.

timeline.detail: Long-term mentorship program begins with 90 students.

timeline.detail: Four-week workshop series teaching 20 young entrepreneurs.

stories.name: Garrett Hauk
stories.headline: From Idea to First Place: Garrett's Gourmet Dog Treats
stories.body: Garrett's Gourmet Dog Treats offers organic, natural, and delicious snacks made with fewer than five ingredients. As a healthier, modern alternative to conventional options, they ensure man's best friend enjoys treats that are both simple and satisfying.

stories.name: Kandice Henning
stories.headline: CEO Shares Journey to Fearless Entrepreneurship
stories.body: Sharing her journey of creating one of Naperville's largest nonprofit organizations, she inspired students to embrace risk, pursue their passions, and lead through social innovation.
